text:
Maria: quick heads-up — thinking of a very lightweight launch for PlayLab Starter Kit (mini tutorial + 30-min live lab + a short benchmark post). want to seed community, get a few early case studies, and route inbound into a gated lab sign-up. who can own the webinar + funnel?
Sam: happy to own funnel + tracking. suggest webinar -> gated repo access -> 1:1 sign-up for pilot. short benchmark blog to show latency/cost on hosted vs dedicated.
Elaine: timeline? we have one week to draft copy if we want to piggyback on next week's newsletter.
Jordan: draft social + blog headline: "PlayLab Starter Kit: Build an app in 30 minutes — benchmarked" — and a 3-bullet measurement plan (latency, tokens/cost, demo throughput).
Maria: love it. Sam, can you sketch the lead routing? we need HubSpot form + segment tagging for pilot leads.
Sam: plan: HubSpot form on gated repo + hidden field utm_campaign=playlab_v1. route to MQL list -> SDR nurture sequence. add property "Pilot Interest" boolean.
Pete: I can run the live demo and record a trimmed 6-min clip for the blog. will do a small demo app showing streaming + fallback routing.
Jordan: quick copy suggestion for tweets:\n
"Try the PlayLab Starter Kit — ship a streaming LLM demo in 30m. Benchmarks for latency & cost: https://playlab.example.com (signup) #opensource #inference"

feel free to shorten.
Maria: @Sam can you add UTM + tracking snippet to the repo README? also need an automated Slack alert to #sales when someone selects Pilot Interest.
Sam: yep — putting this in a tiny script. snippet for README:
```
?utm_source=twitter&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=playlab_v1
```
will also add a webhook to HubSpot -> Slack.
Elaine: assets we need: hero gif (6s), 6-min demo clip, 2 screenshots, copy for email + 3 social cards. assign owners?
Maria: owner matrix: hero gif = Jordan, demo clip = Pete, screenshots = Pete, email copy = Elaine, social cards = Jordan.
CampaignBot: calendar invite created: "PlayLab Launch — dry run" 2025-07-18 10:00AM PT. link: https://calendar.example.com/event/12345
Jordan: benchmark note — use a small public dataset and record median p50/p95 token latency across 100 requests. I'll draft results and a short chart.
Sam: one more ask — add a short Qualaroo popup on the gated page asking "what brings you here?" options: evaluation/pilot/demo. helps routing.
Maria: perfect. next steps: Sam to wire HubSpot + webhook, Jordan to produce assets + benchmark draft, Pete to record demo, Elaine to write email. we'll reconvene in the dry run on Friday. :thumbsup:
Elaine: +1. I'll draft the newsletter blurb and circulate for quick review.
Pete: recording tonight, will post link in thread.
Maria: thanks team — let's keep the launch concise and focused on dev momentum. :rocket:
